M1.name: Gillean of the Battle Axe
M1.note: Eponym of the Macleans; tradition places him at the Battle of Largs, 1263.

M2.name: Iain Dubh
M2.note: Black John. Great-grandson of Gillean; father of the two lines on Mull.

M3.name: Hector Reaganach
M3.note: Hector the Stern, 1st of Lochbuie. Granted lands on Mull by the Lord of the Isles, c. 1350. Built Moy Castle.

M4.name: Lachlan Lubanach
M4.note: Lachlan the Wily. Elder line to Duart. Shown for context; the Duart descent is not traced here.

M5.name: Lochbuie chiefs, 2nd–25th
M5.note: Placeholder for the chiefly succession. Awaiting the Ancestry export.

M6.name: MacFadzean line
M6.note: Placeholder. Sept descent to be traced from the export. Also written MacFadyen and McFadyen.

R1.name: Fearchar mac an t-Sagairt
R1.note: Of the hereditary abbots of Applecross. Knighted 1215; Earl of Ross by 1234.

R2.name: Uilleam I, Earl of Ross
R2.note: Succeeded his father as earl c. 1251.

R3.name: Earls of Ross
R3.note: Placeholder for the Clann Anndrais descent carrying the Anderson name. Awaiting the export.

R4.name: Anderson line
R4.note: Placeholder. Sept descent to be traced from the export.
